title: Index SMP
body:
Index SMP is a reliable SMP PVP texture pack, with all the features you need for pvp on a minecraft SMP.

**Features**
- Low fire
- Low shield
- No eating particles
- Small/low totem pop animation
- Small totem pop particles
- Small handhelds
- Clearer water
- Smaller particles (wind charge, crits)
- Ore outlines
- Transparent effects
- No smoke particles
- No explosion particles
- Smaller rain and snow particles
- Outlined trap chests
- No pumpkin blur
